name: Sparklekeys
author: Harris Kenny
description: Letter Hunt typing tutor for a first keyboard. Play is the hunt; Friends is themed unlock boards; the bar chip is the selected emoji. Unicorn default; dragon stub. Local only.

barWidget.description: Letter Hunt for a first keyboard. Play is hunt-only; Friends is themed unlock boards; the bar chip is the selected emoji. Local only.

schema.label: Character pack
schema.description: The practice-word and accent theme. Unicorn is the v1 default; dragon is a stub to prove pack-swap.

schema.label: Letter case
schema.description: How target letters are shown. Matching is always case-insensitive (no Shift required).

schema.label: Start mode
schema.description: Letter Hunt (one letter) or Word Mode (short pack words).

schema.label: Daily letter goal
schema.description: Correct letters in a local day for the +5 star bonus celebration.

schema.label: Show stars on bar
schema.description: Show the star balance next to the selected friend emoji on the bar chip.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: Play a short cartoon blip on a correct letter (Kenney CC0, bundled). Off is silence. Misses stay quiet.
